text:
rachel: hey team - accepted the GitHub invite but I only see public repos. The org page shows 'Pending organization membership' and a banner about SAML SSO. Can't clone private repos.
devon: did you accept with the exact work account the invite was sent to? sometimes SCIM-provisioned users show up as pending until Okta finishes provisioning.
rachel: I accepted as rachel@redwood.ai. Okta shows me as a provisioned user though. `gh auth status` reports 'SSO: NOT authorized'.
people-ops: onboarding note: for customers using SCIM/SCIM groups, we sometimes need to map the Okta group to the GitHub team. I can check if your SCIM membership synced.
infra-bot: infra-check: user rachel@redwood.ai exists in org but not assigned to any teams via SCIM mapping.
okta-bot: okta: provisioning status for rachel@redwood.ai: success, group assignments pending sync (0m ago).
people-ops: I triggered a manual SCIM sync and re-sent the invite. After you accept, you'll still need to click "Authorize SSO" on the org page to complete SSO linkage (redirects to Okta).
rachel: accepted the new invite. I still don't see an "Authorize SSO" button in my normal browser, gh still says SSO NOT authorized.
devon: try visiting https://github.com/orgs/redwood while signed in and look for "Authorize SSO". If the button is missing, try incognito or a different browser; sometimes extensions or a cached session hide it.
rachel: incognito worked, clicked authorize, approved in Okta. `gh auth status` now shows SSO: authorized.
infra-bot: infra-check: user rachel@redwood.ai now assigned to engineering-core team via SCIM mapping. Repo permissions updated.
rachel: can now see private repos and cloned successfully. One oddity: my org member status showed up before team mapping completed which was confusing.
people-ops: thanks for reporting — we'll add a note to onboarding: when using SCIM provisioning, there can be a small delay between org membership and team assignment; still remember to authorize SSO in the browser. If folks hit this, ping people-ops and we can force a SCIM sync. Welcome aboard, rachel! :tada:
